shots.alt: Ticket Spot Demo navigation with the site selector and Design highlighted
shots.caption: Choose your site from the top-left menu, then use the navigation tabs to open each area.

shots.alt: Brand editor with Upload Image and the primary color swatch highlighted
shots.caption: Open Design → Brand to upload a logo and choose your primary color. The preview shows how the selected brand appears.

shots.alt: Create Membership editor with Pricing and Access Rules highlighted
shots.caption: In Memberships, create a membership and review Pricing, Access Rules, and assigned Events. This example shows a $99 one-year pass.
shots.provenance: Unsaved example form; no membership created

shots.alt: Sunset Yoga event card with Open dashboard and Manage event highlighted
shots.caption: Choose Manage event to edit the event, or Open dashboard to manage its attendees.

shots.alt: Analytics overview with the date range and Sales tab highlighted
shots.caption: Select an event and date range, then switch between Overview, Sales, Attendance, Traffic, Abandoned Carts, and Email.

shots.alt: Attendee dashboard with Add Attendee and search highlighted; identity concealed
shots.caption: Use Add Attendee for a manual registration, search or filter the list, and use Export for a report. Personal details are concealed in this example.
shots.provenance: Live Demo attendee list; name and email masked

shots.alt: Attendee ticket-page preview showing QR access, documents, and contact actions
shots.caption: Attendees can view their QR code, download documents, and contact the host. This built-in preview shows the available sections; hosts control their visibility in Design → Attendee Ticket Page.
shots.provenance: Built-in product preview with sample order data; not a customer order

shots.alt: Check-in launcher with App Store and Google Play installation links circled
shots.caption: From Events → View activity, choose Check In Attendees. Use the mobile installation QR codes or links for iOS and Android, or start desktop check-in.
shots.provenance: Live app installation panel; not a native mobile-app screen

shots.alt: Widget editor with Quick Settings and View all layouts highlighted
shots.caption: Open Design → Widget. Start in Quick Settings, use View all layouts for layout choices, or open All Settings for the complete set of controls.
shots.provenance: Live Demo widget editor and preview

shots.alt: Event platform integration cards with Eventbrite and Ticket Tailor highlighted
shots.caption: In Integrations, find Event Platforms and choose View Details or Connect for the service you want to use.
shots.provenance: Live integration cards; no services connected during capture

shots.alt: Settings navigation with Domains and Sender Identity and Mobile Check-in highlighted
shots.caption: Open Settings to configure domains, sender identity, analytics, event submissions, mobile check-in, and marketplace options.
shots.provenance: Live Demo settings; no settings changed

shots.alt: Platform integration cards showing Shopify connected to Ticket Spot Demo and Wix installation highlighted
shots.caption: Website and ecommerce connections are under Integrations → Platform Integrations. The example shows the Demo Shopify connection alongside Wix and Ecwid.
shots.provenance: Live platform cards; no apps installed during capture

shots.alt: Add team member form with Ticket Checker and Event Manager role selectors circled
shots.caption: Choose Invite Team → Invite Team Member, enter an email address, and select Admin, Ticket Checker, Support Manager, or Event Manager.
shots.provenance: Live invitation form; no invitation sent

shots.alt: Account menu with Account Setting and Notifications highlighted
shots.caption: Open Account in the top-right corner for profile settings, payouts, and notifications. Billing is available separately in the header.
shots.provenance: Live account menu; profile identity cropped out
